contactForm.title: Contact form
contactForm.description: When you use the contact form, the following personal data are collected:

dataCollected.title: Data collected
items: Name: to identify you and personalise the response
Email address: to reply to your enquiry
Subject and message: to handle your request

purpose.title: Purpose of processing
purpose.description: The data provided will be used solely to respond to your enquiry or proposal. They will not be used for any other purpose.

legitimation.title: Legal basis
legitimation.description: Processing is based on your consent, given when submitting the contact form (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).

retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: Form data are sent directly by email and are not stored in the website’s databases. Emails will be kept only as long as necessary to address the enquiry.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.description: Data will not be shared with third parties, unless required by law.

privacy.title: General privacy
items: Umami Analytics is used, a privacy-focused analytics tool that does not collect personal data
Umami does not use tracking cookies or identify individual users
No data are shared with third parties
Only the data you voluntarily provide via the contact form are collected

rights.title: Your rights (GDPR)
rights.description: Under the General Data Protection Regulation, you have the right to:
items: Access: request information about your personal data
Rectification: correct inaccurate or incomplete data
Erasure: request the deletion of your data
Objection: object to the processing of your data
Portability: receive your data in a structured format
Restriction: request a limitation of processing
rights.contact: To exercise these rights, you may contact me by email. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD).
rights.cookiesNote: You can delete this site’s cookies at any time via your browser settings.
